note: Regenerate with GW_SOLVE_PROTOCOL=write go test ./compiler -run TestSolveProtocolMatchesRecord. The default test rebuilds only the final vector and compares everything from final_from_split on. Values are rounded to 6 decimals.
regression: a measure is regressed when solved > hand * 1.0 + eps (strain, strained, torn) or solved < hand - eps (lowest, a floor, only for a region whose hand lowest is under 0.05 m); judged for all poses and for each clip alone; a joint passes when none of its measures is regressed
selection: fewest regressed rows after the worst excess is clamped at 0; then the most vertices blended on the training folds; then grid order. The final vector is the split choice with the smallest held-out worst excess, then fewest held-out failures, then split order.

not_qualified_because: a joint regressed on a measure
